title: The office agent
subtitle: app.buildworkpro.com/leads
_notes: PHONE LINES ARE PLACEHOLDERS for timing. Before any public cut, run the real flow through Grok Bot with a staged test inbox, keep the transcript, re-typeset it into `messages[]`, and set phone.transcriptStatus to "real". The pipeline refuses to render a draft unless DEMO_ALLOW_DRAFT_TRANSCRIPT=1.

App side runs against the local seed tenant (Comfort Climate HVAC, rmoreno). The leads and contacts below are fictional and HVAC-flavored so they fit that tenant; they are created through the same REST surface the MCP tools write through, which is what the agent would have done.

Scene 5 shows the seed's first pay app rather than one the agent drafted (creating a pay app needs a project with a schedule of values). Either seed a draft pay app or cut the scene to the project summary before publishing.
Selectors were written from the app's routes and the existing 03-manage-project script; run `npm run capture -- scripts/04-office.json` once against the seeded app and adjust any that miss.
